chapters.label: Live: the Euro 2026 semi-final
chapters.text: The 2026 Futsal Euro semi-final, in Ljubljana. Spain play Croatia. Mellado is Spain’s ala, a wide player. He scores the second goal, and Spain win two to one!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His trick is the sole roll. Watch how he does it, from the left wing. Sole on the ball, roll it across, and the defender follows. Drag it back, and he is away!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Sole on top, roll, drag back, go!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: roll the ball with the sole of your foot. Keep it close in tight spaces!
